lead_html: F3 Low Pygmy is a minor scale with the ding on F. Start with the i, iv and v chords: play each card's lit notes, then move to the next.
history_html: The name Pygmy was likely first used for handpans by Panart, who built several Pygmy variations in the first Generation Hang years, 2002 to 2005. The same page says the handpan scale has no direct link to traditional Pygmy music, and calls it one of the most popular handpan scales. This 18 note layout adds bottom shell notes to the F Pygmy core.
progression_tail_html: , top shell and bottom shell. Bb and Db exist only on the bottom shell.
